title: Special Bulk Regulations for Cottage Envelope Buildings
previewText: The provisions of this Section, inclusive, are optional, and are only applicable to zoning lots located wholly or partially within flood zones. The provisions of this Section, inclusive, may be applied to zoning lots with cottage envelope buildings. For such zoning lots, the underlying bulk regulations shall apply, except where permitted to be modified by this Section, inclusive.
